narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational historical summary of the Ryukyuan (Okinawan) people's involvement in Taiwan's 228 Incident. It highlights the story of Aoyama Keisaki, the first foreigner to be officially recognized and compensated by the Taiwanese government as a victim of the event, aiming to promote historical reflection and awareness.
